    caveats in this file, including the ladder's very first tier-2 question).
    Belongs in the small-crosswalks pack (#31) and was missing from it.

## Structurally dark — harm-heavy sources with zero verified connections

- **DEA ARCOS opioid shipments** (fed_dea_arcos_full, 178.6M rows) — reaches other sources only by name+zip; its DEA number joins nothing; would connect to the NPI prescriber world via a DEA→NPI crosswalk and to counties via ZIP crosswalk.
- **CourtListener dockets and judges** (71.7M dockets, zero edges; judge disclosures/investments carry no outward keys) — would connect to the entity spine via party-name resolution and to companies via an investment-description→CIK table; note the newest judge-money marts postdate the graph build — rebuild before declaring the gap.
- **Sanctions and screening lists** (OFAC SDN, EU, UN, UK, OpenSanctions, Consolidated Screening List, FHFA suspended counterparties) — all name-only, zero edges; would connect via LEI for entities and alias-aware name matching for the rest; SDN vessel rows carry IMO toward AIS.
- **NOAA AIS ship tracks** (58.1M pings) — IMO ~56% sentinel-masked, no edges; would connect to OFAC vessels on a cleaned IMO subset (key on MMSI, never raw IMO).
- **ICIJ Offshore Leaks** (entities + 771k officers) — name-only; would connect to UK PSC and GLEIF by name with birth-date/address corroboration.
- **ICE detention** (2.6M person-level stints, facility codes/list) — zero verified edges; the designed stint↔facility-code key is unverified; facility list needs geocoding to FIPS; person-hash stability unaudited.
- **FDA device injuries** (MAUDE 2.7M of 25.7M loaded; GUDID 5.1M) — no keys in the graph; would connect via product code / UDI once measured.
- **National Practitioner Data Bank** (fed_hrsa_npdb, 1.9M) — de-identified by design; only state-level rollups will ever work.
- **Immigration courts** (EOIR, 12.6M rows) — a husk with one real column; nothing to join until reloaded.
- **CPSC product injuries (NEISS)** — zero edges; gated on the code table and survey weights.
- **FBI crime data** — county column broken cast; the ORI agency identifier is the real key and its population is unverified.
- **NHTSA complaints/recalls/investigations** (4.5M complaints) — vocabulary joins unverified; no graph edges.
- **Senate lobbying (LDA)** — name-only AND ~9% loaded; doubly blocked.
- **CFPB complaints** (34M rows) — zero hard-ID edges; company strings are consumer brands needing a brand→legal-entity bridge.
- **PPP loans** (968k rows — far below the known program size) — zero edges; check for a borrower EIN before name-matching.
- **Senate stock trades** — name-only, coverage ends Dec 2020, journalism-use-only by law.
- **NCUA credit unions** — out of the spine entirely (dead EIN key removed, replacement tables carry no hard ID); the credit-union side of banking is dark.
- **FracFocus + USGS orphaned wells** (7.2M + 118k) — neither has any verified edge; API well number is the candidate key.
- **Retraction Watch and ransomware victims** (71k + 29k) — no edges; institution/company names need ROR or ticker resolution; both on the wrong-publisher-total list.

## Broken-model bugs found in passing (worth fixing regardless)

- try_to_number casts null out text values across many marts: country/ISO columns in ≥12 sources, plus Mapping Police Violence's county column, FBI CDE's county column, and the PECOS control id.
- FDIC call-reports mart captured page HTML instead of data (a doctype_html column; 302 rows) — the scrape needs re-ingesting.
- Header-eating loader: an FDA drug-label mart ate its first data row as the header and renamed columns positionally (one record lost, alignment suspect); Canada's drug registry mart has the same positional-rename defect; Spain's open-data portal mart is explicitly defective from a loader parse bug.
- MSHA county FIPS is number-cast in the model, stripping leading zeros — a known broken join to QCEW until the cast is fixed.
- USASpending FIPS text columns lost leading zeros on both 20M-row tables.
- The nursing-home MDS mart's county_name is mis-typed as a number.
- A shortage-area mart's poverty column name is mangled by a header-parsing problem.
- The VA appendix mart is 144 rows of unnamed columns (headers never parsed) — unusable until rebuilt.
- Fed H.15 rates: the date column is buried inside a description field; the companion Fed series mart is raw series codes with no label dictionary (304 rows, hundreds of unlabeled columns).
- SEC 13F othermanager is a positional reference code unusable without resolving against the cover-page table.
- FDIC Summary of Deposits mart exposes no named columns; a FEMA mart is an unaliased passthrough — both need column verification before any join.
- CFPB complaints row count disagrees with itself (34M vs 17M between catalog and mart comment) — a duplicated or partially reloaded table.
- UN sanctions last-updated field is a raw JSON blob whose date cast nulls; partial birth-year strings also null on casting.
- CourtListener positions vote-percent columns are ~100% null (raw yes/no tallies unverified); the investments "500k cap" was a wrong header count, re-verified at 1.9M on 2026-08-11.
- NOAA storm events zone-FIPS is sometimes a forecast zone, not a county — must drop zone rows before any FIPS join.
- Silent join-killers: CIK zero-padding differs between sources, EIN dash-formats differ, and untyped YYYYMMDD/YYYYMM date text hits the epoch parse trap (SEC filing dates, IRS ruling dates); SEC financials also shows a catalog-vs-mart row mismatch suggesting a partial load.
